title: African Development Bank Group — Seychelles, Economic Resilience and Green Recovery Support Programme phase III, 2026
description: "The Board of Directors of the African Development Bank Group has approved a $34 million loan to Seychelles to strengthen economic resilience, improve public services, expand private sector opportunities, and advance the country's transition towards greener and more inclusive growth." "Approved on 22 September, the loan will fund the third and final phase of the Economic Resilience and Green Recovery Support Programme (ERGRSP-III), supporting reforms across three connected areas: economic governance and public financial management, business environment, and climate resilience." "ERGRSP-III will build on this progress by supporting the modernisation of public financial management systems, including electronic invoicing for tax compliance and a national e-procurement system. Reforms will also establish a one-stop investment portal and Government Business Service Centre to make it easier for investors and entrepreneurs to access approvals and business services." "The Bank has provided $25 million for each of the first two phases, in 2024 and 2025, bringing the Bank Group's total financing across the three phases to $84 million."

title: Hustle Fund — Fusepay pre-seed, 2025
description: "The rollout follows a $350,000 pre-seed round in August backed by Hustle Fund, Everywhere Ventures, First Check Ventures, Startup Istanbul, and angel investor Ryan Nesbitt." Fusepay offers virtual business accounts, instant transfers, post-dated digital payments to replace cheques, and automated reconciliation.

title: Cable & Wireless Seychelles Debt Refinancing and Digital Transformation Facility
description: TDB provided a USD 50 million funding package to refinance Cable & Wireless Seychelles' outstanding debt of USD 48.1 million from the original 2019 acquisition loan. The package includes bridging and term loan facilities, a USD 5 million convertible note (convertible to CWS equity at time of share listing), and a term loan in Seychelles Rupees. The transaction also supports CWS's digital transformation activities including eBill and self-care platforms, online registrations, and bill payments. CWS is exploring fintech innovations through Nebula Fintech Limited. Following the restructuring, TDB also acquired approximately 2.9% equity stake in CWS via an off-market transaction (December 2022). CWS subsequently listed on MERJ Exchange Seychelles in September 2022.

title: World Bank — Seychelles Social Protection System PforR, 2021
description: Project Appraisal Document (PAD3541, 3 March 2021) for the Seychelles Strengthening the Quality of the Social Protection System Program-for-Results — a US$30m PforR operation. The in-scope digital element is the social-protection registry/MIS (subject `dpi.registry`).

title: Cable & Wireless Seychelles Acquisition Financing
description: TDB served as Mandated Lead Arranger for a USD 70 million syndicated acquisition financing for CWS Investment Ltd (a group of Seychellois entrepreneurs) to acquire Cable & Wireless Seychelles (CWS) from Liberty Latin America. TDB provided USD 50 million of its own balance sheet, with co-lending from Absa Group Limited and ABC Banking Corporation of Mauritius. CWS is Seychelles' leading ICT/telecoms operator, providing fixed-line, mobile, broadband, and FTTH services, placing CWS into 100% local ownership for the first time. The deal was TDB's largest transaction in Seychelles to date.
